ultra-disk-vcpu-reservation-conditional.title: Ultra Disk vCPU reservation applies only while no ultra disk is attached
ultra-disk-vcpu-reservation-conditional.body: This estimate charges the per-vCPU Ultra Disk reservation. Microsoft states it applies only when Ultra Disk capability is enabled on a VM with no ultra disk attached. If an ultra disk will be attached to that VM, remove the reservation line.

citation.quote: The reservation charge is only imposed if you enabled Ultra Disk capability on the VM without an attached Ultra Disk.
